name: Dunn-Kempf
description: Classical tabletop miniatures wargame used in military professional education, associated with the tradition of tactical-level ground combat modeling developed by Michael Dunn and others. Models ground combat operations at the tactical level with emergent force-on-force dynamics. Used in war colleges and PME institutions as a pedagogical tool for tactical decision-making.
reputation: historically significant in military professional education miniatures wargaming tradition; republished for continued PME use
notes: Classical miniatures system representative of the tactical wargaming tradition used in officer professional education. Limited public documentation available; details vary by republished edition.
